title: Cryptographic baseline (PLANNED, v1)
description: DESIGN ONLY. MacGuard Cloud does not exist. A baseline is a sealed, hash-linked snapshot of the expected state of a host or host group (set of file hashes and configuration digests). A later audit compares against it. The baseline is tied to a signer and to a trusted timestamp; it is append-only (a change is a new baseline that names its predecessor).

previous_baseline_sha256.description: Hash of the previous baseline document; absent only for the first one.

root.description: Merkle root (RFC 9162 style, as the existing rules_root) over the sorted leaf list.

entries.description: Optional inline leaves; large baselines carry only root and a retrievable blob digest.

tools.description: Versions of the tools that produced it.
